problems.theorem_title: Positive exponential decay of the Sondow integrals
problems.formal_statement:
theorem EulerMascheroni.Sondow.integral_bounds (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    0 < I n ∧ I n < (1/16:ℝ)^n := by sorry
problems.natural_language_statement:
For every positive integer $n$,
$$0<I_n<16^{-n}.$$
This is the integral part of Sondow's Lemma 3. It does not use a bound for the least common multiple or the integral evaluation involving Euler's constant.
problems.source: J. Sondow, https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0209070, v2 (2002). Lemma 3, p. 10. An alternative elementary majorant is proved in the submitted solution.

problems.theorem_title: Vanishing of the Sondow geometric-series remainder
problems.preamble:
import Definitions.Def_eulerMascheroni_sondowCutoff
open EulerMascheroni.Sondow Filter
open scoped Topology
problems.formal_statement:
theorem EulerMascheroni.Sondow.remainder_tendsto_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Tendsto (remainder n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by sorry
problems.natural_language_statement:
For each fixed positive integer $n$,
$$\lim_{N\to\infty}R_{n,N}=0.$$
This justifies removing the geometric-series cutoff in the double integral.
problems.source: J. Sondow, https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0209070, v2 (2002). Equation (9), p. 7, and the vanishing-remainder argument, p. 9.

problems.theorem_title: Vanishing finite-shift correction in Sondow evaluation
problems.preamble:
import Definitions.Def_eulerMascheroni_sondowCutoff
open EulerMascheroni.Sondow Filter
open scoped Topology
problems.formal_statement:
theorem EulerMascheroni.Sondow.cutoffError_tendsto_zero (n : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (cutoffError n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by sorry
problems.natural_language_statement:
For every fixed nonnegative integer $n$,
$$\lim_{N\to\infty}E_{n,N}=0.$$
This records the elementary limits of the finite harmonic and logarithmic shifts in the cutoff evaluation. The case $n=0$ is included.
problems.source: J. Sondow, https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0209070, v2 (2002). Finite-shift asymptotics immediately preceding equation (11), p. 8; explicit rearrangement into the defined correction.

problems.theorem_title: Finite cutoff evaluation for Sondow integrals
problems.formal_statement:
theorem EulerMascheroni.Sondow.finite_cutoff_identity (n N : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hN : 0 < N) :
    I n - remainder n N = ((2*n).choose n : ℝ) *
      ((harmonic N : ℝ)-Real.log N) + L n - (A n : ℝ) + cutoffError n N := by sorry
problems.natural_language_statement:
For positive integers $n,N$,
$$I_n-R_{n,N}=\binom{2n}{n}(H_N-\log N)+L_n-A_n+E_{n,N}.$$
This finite identity combines the binomial expansion, integration of the geometric truncation, and the combinatorial identification of the logarithmic form. It is a known source-derived identity awaiting formalization; it assumes no irrationality conjecture.
problems.source: J. Sondow, https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0209070, v2 (2002). Finite evaluation, p. 8, with equations (6), (8), (11), the binomial identities on p. 9, and Lemma 2. The displayed statement is an exact rearrangement for N>0.
